summary: One VivaCity camera covering 13 zones at Erskineville Rd / Swanson St, 2023-07 to 2026-09, with camera-wide outages in March 2024, early January 2025 and May-June 2025 that the automatic fixes mostly handle. The counts step up abruptly mid-afternoon on 2024-01-24 (all zones about x2) and 2024-10-02 (zone-specific, up to x15) while nearby counters stay flat, so each direction is split into three series at those dates. zero_outage wrongly removed genuine zeros in near-empty zones (767, 770, 947), which are restored, and outage zeros kept in low-volume zones in January 2025 are set missing.
